newsitem.title: USA: Unocal starts stock repurchase program.
newsitem.headline: Unocal starts stock repurchase program.

text.p: Unocal Corp said it will begin its previously announced common stock repurchase program.

The company's board has authorized the repurchase of up to $400 million of the company's stock. If the entire authorized amount is repurchased, it would represent about 4 percent of Unocal's outstanding 250 million shares of common stock, based on the current market price.

The common shares will be repurchased through open market or privately negotiated transactions at the discretion of company management, depending upon financial and market conditions or as otherwise permitted under applicable rules.
